stats_dashboard.card: p-6 border border-stone-800 bg-[#0C0C0C] flex flex-col gap-2

main_content.toolbar: flex justify-between items-center p-4 border border-stone-800 bg-[#0C0C0C]

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Hard cuts on color changes (no slow fades) to emphasize tool functionality.
interactions_and_motion.scan_progress: Use an indeterminate neon loader (like a terminal cursor or green binary scanning effect) when folder scan is active.
interactions_and_motion.row_click: Highlight the entire table row in 5% white (#FFFFFF0D) when hovered to aid tracking.

icons.style: duotone for headers, regular for table actions

testing_attributes.guideline: All interactive elements MUST use descriptive data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode is forced on the layout application-wide.
Do NOT use typical rounded Shadcn Cards; strip borders, force square corners (rounded-none), and use pure 1px lines (border-stone-800).
Implement the table using pure HTML/Tailwind or heavily customized Shadcn Table for maximum data density (py-2 or py-3 instead of py-4).
Ensure the progress indicator utilizes a terminal-style look (e.g., green monospace text percentage and a blocky progress bar).
Integrate the 'Nano Banana vs GPT Image 1' selection inside a dense 'Fix Action' modal, utilizing the provided sample images as previews.
